messages:
maria: Quick pulse on token-cost attribution instrumentation — want to lock schema + owners for rollout this week. TL;DR: need schema sign-off, ingest pipeline plan, and latency tagging decisions. Who can own which piece?

ajay: I can take ingestion (kafka -> enrichment -> events). ETA Thurs EOD to map fields in the pipeline. I need a sample event to validate size and throughput impact.

sam: I can handle model-side tagging (route/model_version/token counts). Two quick q's: 1) do we want per-token cost baked in, or derive from counts + price table? 2) KV-cache hits — should we emit a separate cache event or add fields to the same event?

dena: +1 on a single enriched event (simpler join). Include cache_hit boolean and cache_ttl_ms. Draft schema below (very small):

```json
{
  "event_type": "token_attrib_v1",
  "ts": "ISO8601",
  "user_id": "anon_user_id",
  "route_name": "chat.compose",
  "model": "redwood/llama-70b-v1",
  "model_version": "2026-03-10",
  "tokens_generated": 124,
  "tokens_prompt": 34,
  "tokens_completion": 90,
  "token_price_cents": 12,
  "cost_cents": 1488,
  "latency_ms_total": 430,
  "latency_ms_decode": 210,
  "latency_ms_attention": 120,
  "cache_hit": false,
  "cache_ttl_ms": null
}
```

dena: We should also include a small "sample_payload_size_bytes" field so Ajay can estimate bandwidth.

pat: I will sync with billing & analytics. Important: retention TTL and PII removal. We should store user_id as a hashed id only. Also confirm if cost_cents is pre- or post-discount — prefer raw per-token cost and keep billing adjustments separate. I'll own the billing mapping work — will take PR review once schema is live. @maria please confirm retention policy target (30d/90d).

maria: Let's do 90d for raw events, and 365d aggregated metrics. Agreed on hashed user_id and raw per-token price.

ajay: I'll spin up a staging canary to validate event size. Expect ~+3-6% payload. If we include too many latency subfields we might want to compress names (we can map during ingestion).

sam: I'll add route_name and model_version at emission time. For per-token cost: I'd prefer we emit token_price_cents so downstream can recalc if price table changes.

maria: Action items: 1) dena — open schema PR with the draft above and add sample Avro/BigQuery mapping (owner: dena) — target Wed EOD. 2) ajay — run staging canary and report throughput/size delta (owner: ajay) — target Thurs EOD. 3) sam — prod instrumentation changes for route+counts (owner: sam) — PR by Wed. 4) pat — billing mapping & retention plan (owner: pat) — review by Fri.

ajay: Noted. Also call out dependency on msgpack encoder update in ingestion (small change). I'll include that in the canary run.

dena: I'll include sample SQL for aggregated metrics:

```sql
SELECT date(ts) as day, model, route_name, SUM(cost_cents)/100.0 as usd_cost, AVG(latency_ms_total) as avg_latency_ms
FROM token_attrib_v1
GROUP BY day, model, route_name
```

pat: FYI billing team asked if we can flag events that are part of free-tier credits so they don't get double-billed. Add optional boolean "promo_credit_applied".

maria: Add that as optional. Good catch.

deploy-bot: Canary job started: token-attrib-canary-2026-03-11 (job id 8821). Triggered by ajay.

ajay: Canary finished: token-attrib-canary-2026-03-11 — checks: schema-compat (pass), size-regression (pass, +4%), ingest-throughput (pass). Will post PR link shortly. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks all — let's aim to merge schema PR Wed morning then coordinate a short maintenance window Thurs for rollout. If any blocker pops up ping this thread. :eyes:
